questions.question: If 15th October 2008 was a Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 14th October 2012?
questions.solution:
In any two consecutive ordinary years, date of the next year will be one day ahead of the same date of the previous year

15th October 2008 = Wednesday

15th October 2009 = Thursday

15th October 2010 = Friday

15th October 2011 = Saturday

If a leap year comes immediately after an ordinary year, then the day on a certain date of the leap year will be 2 days ahead of the same date on the ordinary year from March to December.

15th October 2012 = Monday(Leap year)

14th October 2012 = Sunday (One day before 15th October 2012)

Hence, the correct answer is **option(1)**.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc029b549c59f7f5debf9f398b3841c649d8de85dba8131c7c638212401bba8d.png] 

Option 1) : ÷ and +

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 ÷ 14 × 7 + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ __**28 ÷ 14**__ × 7 + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ __**2 × 7**__ + 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ __**14 + 5**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**19 - 18**__ = 20

⇒ 1 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : ÷ and –

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 + 14 × 7 - 5 ÷ 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + 14 × 7 - __**5 ÷ 18**__ = 20

⇒ 28 + __**14 × 7**__ - 0.277 = 20

⇒ __**28 + 98**__ - 0.277 = 20

⇒ __**126 - 0.277**__ = 20

⇒ 125.722 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ÷ and ×

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 + 14 ÷ 7 × 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + __**14 ÷ 7**__ × 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 + __**2 × 5**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**28 + 10**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**38 - 18**__ = 20

⇒ **20 = 20**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : + and ×

Given equation is : 28 + 14 × 7 ÷ 5 – 18 = 20

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 28 × 14 + 7 ÷ 5 - 18 = 20

⇒ 28 × 14 + __**7 ÷ 5**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**28 × 14**__ + 1.4 - 18 = 20

⇒ __**392 + 1.4**__ - 18 = 20

⇒ __**393.4 - 18**__ = 20

⇒ 375.4 ≠ 20

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and ×".**

questions.question: Where does **Narmada **river discharge?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulf of Khambhat**__.

__
 
• The **Narmada River **flows through various states and finally drains into the **Gulf of Khambhat in the Arabian Sea**.
 
• The Source of the Narmada is **Narmada Kund** which is located at **Amarkantak **in **Anuppur District**.

• The **Narmada River** also called the Reva.
 
• **Narmada River **is the **third-longest river** that flows entirely within India after the **Godavari** and the **Krishna**. 
 
• The length of the Narmada River is **1312 km** with a coverage area of **98,796 sq. km**.
 
• Narmada River has numerous waterfalls, mainly the** Dhuandhar Falls** in Jabalpur district.
 
• The **Tawa River** is the biggest tributary of the Narmada River other than **Sher**, **Shakkar**, and **Dudhi**.
